title: Pure Gem-Knight

allow.Scatter Fusion: Gem-Knight support the API files under Fusion: it only Fusion Summons non-Rock Gem-Knights, and Gem-Knight Quartz sets it from the Deck.

summary: Gem-Knight cards and the Gem- support around them, with generic staples. The 2025 wave leads. Gem-Knight Nepyrim searches any Gem-Knight card and grants an extra Gem- Normal Summon, and Gem-Knight Dispersion either searches a Gem- monster or Fusion Summons with up to two non-Rock Gem-Knights from the Deck or Extra Deck. Gem-Knight Hollowcore summons itself by milling Gem-Knight Fusion and negates on the opponent's turn. Gem-Knight Master Diamond Dispersion sends itself to the GY on either turn to summon three non-Rock Gem- Fusions with different names, ignoring their conditions, so the Extra Deck carries one of each Type. Gem-Knight Fusion returns from the GY by banishing a Gem-Knight, so every turn has a Fusion.
